title: Learn Low Poly Modeling in Blender 2.9 / 2.8
summary: Imphenzia's 83-minute tutorial covers the low poly modeling techniques he learned over five years of Blender use, with timestamps from navigation and extrusion onward. It uses Blender 2.83 with default keys.
why: It is the most-recommended beginner Blender tutorial on HN, with several people saying it made them comfortable in a couple of hours.
